assumptions: Samples numbered downcore, so S12 is oldest and S1 youngest; change = H(S1) - H(S12).
Columns c1-c9 are taxa; raw counts used, no rarefaction.
issues: Sample totals differ (S1 ~217 vs S12 ~397), so Shannon may be affected by sample size; not corrected.
summary: Computed Shannon (ln) for S1 and S12 from counts and took S1 minus S12.
